author: Nfs7887
quote: This game already isnt my style of game but then comes the fact that it looks horrible. Dont get me wrong, the graphics are great when its an image but with 30 fps it just looks unpolished, especially when playing this right after ocarina of time wich had incredible performance and graphics. Then the game is also just really boring. I played for a few hours and then sold both the console i got just for the game and the game jtself. And its also just full of bugs. The game crashed 3 times before being able to play it and NPCs were just running against walls or textures didnt load or just me falling out the map for no reason. Very unpolished game even though it looks good. Can be fun for some people but not for me, sorry.
